what_it_does: Unique identifier for this controller instance. Other strategy components use it to route executor actions and reports.
Controller module name. This must match the controller implementation and is used when loading the controller from the YAML file.
Controller family used for grouping/loading the controller. In this repo the main families are generic, directional_trading, and market_making.
Total budget in quote currency that the controller uses when sizing positions, grids, or quote-side order allocations.
Manual per-controller stop flag. In the `v2_with_controllers` script, setting this to true stops the controller and issues StopExecutor actions for its executors; clearing it allows restart.
List of pre-existing positions that the controller should adopt and manage at startup instead of assuming a flat book.
Connector on which the pre-existing position exists.
Trading pair of the pre-existing position.
Base-asset amount currently held in that initial position.
Direction of the initial position (`BUY` for long/base inventory, `SELL` for short inventory).
Exchange/connector name that the controller uses for trading or market data.
Market symbol the controller trades or monitors, in `BASE-QUOTE` form.
Maximum number of concurrent executors the directional controller may keep open on each side (long/buy or short/sell).
Minimum wait time between signal/executor creations or rebalance actions, depending on the controller.
Leverage applied when the connector supports perpetual or margin trading.
Perpetual position mode. Typical values are `HEDGE` and `ONEWAY`.
Relative loss threshold that closes an executor/position when exceeded.
Relative profit threshold that closes an executor/position when reached.
Maximum time in seconds that an executor/position may remain open before it is closed.
Integer enum for the order type used when placing the take-profit exit order. Values: 1=MARKET 2=LIMIT 3=LIMIT_MAKER.
Trailing-stop configuration. In prompts this is entered as `activation_price,trailing_delta`; in YAML it can serialize as an object.
Profit distance/trigger at which the trailing stop becomes active.
Distance the stop trails behind price once the trailing stop has activated.
Minimum long probability required for the AI livestream controller to emit a buy/long signal.
Minimum short probability required for the AI livestream controller to emit a sell/short signal.
MQTT topic prefix from which the controller reads ML predictions. The strategy appends the normalized trading pair and `/ML_SIGNALS`.
